summary: Alps Group Inc, a Malaysian foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq under ALPS, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 12, 2026 press release announcing the launch of a Pharmaco-Interaction (PCI) laboratory unit within its MyGenome subsidiary; the unit debuts with CYP450 inhibitory IC50 testing across seven major enzyme isoforms. The filing is an ordinary business/product-launch disclosure with no transaction, no stated price, stake, premium, or closing date. No board recommendation or financial advisor is named. No structural or regulatory mechanics apply; this is routine operational news, not a special situation.
